name: meta_config
description: Query meta running configuration. Optional JSONPath filter.

name: meta_config_apply
description: Apply a config patch to the running meta service.

name: meta_detail
description: Full detail for a single meta, with optional archive history. Response includes phaseState, owedPhase, and crossRefs.

path.description: Path to .meta/ directory or owner directory.

includeArchive.description: false (default), true (all snapshots), or number (N most recent).

name: meta_list
description: List metas with summary stats and per-meta projection. Response includes phaseState and owedPhase per meta.

filter.description: Structured filter. Supported keys: hasError (boolean), staleHours (number), neverSynthesized (boolean), locked (boolean), disabled (boolean).

name: meta_preview
description: Dry-run preview of next synthesis. Returns owedPhase, priorityBand, phaseState, inputStatus, and architectInvalidators.

path.description: Optional: specific .meta/ path to preview. If omitted, previews the stalest candidate.

name: meta_queue
description: Queue management. list: List queued synthesis operations (3-layer model: current, overrides, automatic). clear: Clear override entries from the queue. abort: Abort the currently running synthesis.

action.description: Queue action: list (show state), clear (remove pending), abort (stop current synthesis).

name: meta_seed
description: Create a .meta/ directory and initial meta.json for a new entity path.

path.description: Owner directory path to seed with .meta/ and meta.json.

crossRefs.description: JSON array of cross-ref owner paths (e.g. '["<drive label>:/path/a","<drive label>:/path/b"]'). Use server_drives to discover available drive labels.

steer.description: Steering prompt written as _steer in the initial meta.json.

name: meta_service
description: Manage the meta system service. Actions: install, uninstall, start, stop, restart, status.

name: meta_status
description: Get meta service health, version, and uptime.

name: meta_trigger
description: Trigger synthesis. Path-targeted creates an override queue entry; returns owedPhase. Fully-fresh metas return status:skipped.

path.description: Optional: specific .meta/ or owner path to synthesize.

name: meta_unlock
description: Remove a stale .lock from a meta entity that is stuck.

path.description: Path to the .meta/ directory or owner directory.

name: meta_update
description: Update user-settable reserved properties on a meta entity. Returns { path, meta } with large fields excluded. Rejects unknown property keys with a 400 error.

path.description: Path to the .meta/ directory or owner directory.

updates.description: Properties to set. Supported: _steer, _emphasis, _depth, _crossRefs, _disabled. Set to null to remove.
